source_notes: EDITORIAL. The combined impression of lens stray light and in-emulsion spreading, authored for look and explicitly not a measured property of any medium.

Runs on the SCENE, before the observer. P0 measured the old post-B2 operator seeing 0.73 EV of overrange where the scene offered 6.00 — the effect it was named for cannot be produced in the display domain at any strength.

Three detection rungs, each with its own diffusion radius: a filament (finest rung, full-resolution detection), a neon tube or window mullion (60 um), a blown window or sky (400 um). Weights fall with scale so the frame-wide veil stays subordinate to the local glow.
save_lights 0.35 with a 0.15-0.75 core ratio: enough to keep a source core from washing out, well short of the hollow ring a hard max() produces.
